message.content: Jasper specifically mentions the development of Phil Foden under Guardiola. He highlights how Foden has flourished and grown substantially during his time with Guardiola, indicating that Guardiola knows how to extract the best performance from his players. This points to Guardiola's ability to nurture and develop young talent, which is a recurring theme in the discussions about his management style and the success of the teams he has led.
